name: my-12--deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017
question: Do employers in Malaysia have to make EPF contributions for foreign (non-Malaysian) workers, and at what rate?
answer: Yes. Since 1 October 2025, employers in Malaysia must make EPF contributions for all foreign workers (non-Malaysian) under a valid employment pass or work permit, except domestic servants. The mandatory rate is 2% of the employee's monthly wages, contributed by the employer, with no employee share required. Employers must register with EPF and pay monthly. Previously, EPF contributions for foreign workers were voluntary; the new rule makes them compulsory. Note that domestic servants remain exempt, and the 2% rate applies to both employer and any voluntary employee contributions.
